historical_authority.metadata_note: The historical eight Expansion bullets are transport/grouping lines, not eight acceptance units. Current execution compiles them into 122 semicolon-delimited mandatory learner surface/family groups while preserving grouped-line provenance.

review_model: dual-track: migration fidelity + latest semantic target under current LEARNING_CONTRACT; historical authority is evidence, not immutable truth

core.rule: all other historical R18 Core targets are defective or require a latest-target upgrade at current evidence

severe_examples.word:profession: carrier inversion: Current Active retains the formal declaration sense while the ordinary trained occupation/professional-field carrier is absent
severe_examples.word:property: Current keeps owned-thing plus theatrical property while the useful attribute/characteristic boundary is absent and the theatrical branch remains learner-visible
severe_examples.word:queer: Current foregrounds a dated verb and a slur-marked noun but lacks the modern reclaimed identity adjective/noun and its register boundary
severe_examples.word:rabbit: ordinary animal sense is absent while meat, hunting verb and obsolete curse-like verb survive
severe_examples.word:real: true/actual/genuine Core is absent while historical currencies and informal intensifier survive
severe_examples.word:recession: economic contraction Core is absent while generic withdrawal/receding survives
severe_examples.word:recipe: ordinary cooking instructions are absent while archaic medical prescription survives
severe_examples.word:rectify: ordinary correct/put-right Core is absent while technical electrical rectification survives
severe_examples.word:reed: plant/instrument Core is absent while weak-person metaphor survives
severe_examples.word:relation: ordinary connection sense is absent while kin relation and archaic narration survive
severe_examples.word:refuge: ordinary shelter/protection noun is absent while rare refuge-as-verb survives

fresh_semantic_judgments.latest: trained occupation/professional field is the learner Core; declaration/profession-of-belief is formal/lower, with by profession preserved
unify commitment noun/verb access while preserving future potential as a real branch; promise to/promise sb/promise that must bind to live carriers
organize owned property/real estate and characteristic/attribute as useful boundaries; theatrical property/prop is lower-domain recognition
modern reclaimed identity adjective/noun requires explicit current register guidance; historical slur/different/verb uses must not be learner-default
ordinary animal is mandatory Core; meat is a useful extension; hunting and obsolete curse-like verbs are reference-level
span/series and range from A to B are learner Core; mountain/shooting/ranch senses are lower branches rather than the organizing model
true/actual/genuine is mandatory Core; historical currencies are reference-only identities, informal real as intensifier requires register control
economic contraction is mandatory Core; generic receding/withdrawal is lower technical recognition
cooking instructions plus figurative recipe for are learner Core; archaic medical prescription is reference-only
correct/put right is mandatory Core; electrical rectification and distillation are technical lower branches
preserve the true heteronym: verb reject vs noun waste; attributive refuse is handled under the waste noun, not as a separate learner sense
regime centers a system of rule/government; plan/routine use is usage-sensitive and must contrast explicitly with regimen
connection/relationship is mandatory Core; kin meaning is a branch; archaic narration is reference-level
comment noun/verb plus remark on/upon must bind to live carriers; archaic notice meanings remain demoted
generic republican and US-party Republican require explicit case-sensitive identity rather than four lower-case POS-created learner senses
systematic investigation is one semantic model across noun/verb; research into/on and conduct research are surface-level constructions, while pronunciation stress belongs to Word-form data
